sources.quote: 4.3 A supplier with status conditional may not receive new parts.
Then I revoke Dora's approval for HB-620 today and set Dora to conditional.

findings.why: Fonderia Dora is conditional since 2026-09-15 (QS-D-2026 replaced the approved QS-D-2022), and the conditional status has not been lifted. It may not receive new business or parts.

sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that

findings.why: The statement that Dora is still on the approved list is outdated. APR-009 was superseded by APR-010, which is revoked. The only current approval for HB-620 at PLT-PIN for CUST-NOR is APR-011 for SUP-H, not SUP-D.
